Sr. Pre-qualification Criteria

Technical Pre-qualification criteria: 1. Approved Make: The offered make of Lightning Arresters shall be from the latest MSETCL -approved vendor list applicable to the respective equipment. 2. Bidder Eligibility: The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the o ffered Lightning Arresters. In case of an authorized dealer/channel partner, a valid authorizati on certificate issued by the OEM shall be submitted along with the bid. Purchase Orders place d directly on the OEM shall also be considered acceptable as experience documents. 3. Past Supply Experience: The bidder/OEM shall have successfully supplied Porcelain Type Lightning Arresters of 100 kV or higher voltage class against Purchase Orders during the last s even (07) years, reckoned from the date of NIT/Bid document. 4. Documentary Evidence: The bidder shall submit the following documents as evidence of successful supply and acceptance: 1 Copies of Purchase Orders / Work Orders. GeM CRAC (Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate) & Tax Invoice. Completion Certificate/Customer Acceptance Certificate. Documentary proof of receipt of payment against the executed order. 5. Type Test Certificates: The bidder shall submit valid Type Test Certificates for the offere d Lightning Arresters or equipment of equal or higher rating, issued by a NABL-accredited labo ratory or an internationally recognized testing laboratory. The type tests shall have been cond ucted within the last seven (07) years, reckoned from the date of NIT/Bid document, in accord ance with the applicable latest editions of relevant IS/IEC standards for Metal Oxide Gapless S urge Arresters. Relaxation in Experience criteria for eligible startup as per attached annexure The complete Lightning Arrester and GI mounting structure shall be guaranteed ag ainst defects in design, material and workmanship. Guarantee Pe 2 riod Minimum 18 months from date of supply or 12 months from date of commissioning/ installation, whichever is later, unless the RCF commercial conditions specify a long er period. Payment terms for MSME Bidders:

i) In respect of suppliers registered as Micro or Small Enterprises under the MSMED Act, 2006 and holding a valid Udyam Registration Certificate, payment shall be released on any one of the Tr eds Platform registered with RBI as decided by RCF. (ii) In case the Bidder has opted for discounting of the Invoice through any one of the RBI regi stered platforms then the payment will be released on such platform as decided by the Contractor. Disputes and Arbitration Clause: a. Arbitration in case of Domestic vendor In case of any dispute, difference, or question which may at any time arise between the parties hereto or a ny person claiming under them, touching or arising out of or in respect of this agreement or the subject m atter thereof shall be referred to the arbitration. Both the parties shall appoint the sole arbitrator with mut ual agreement in line with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and as amended from time to time shall apply to the proceedings conducted under t he arbitration. In case the party (parties) fail to appoint the sole arbitrator within 30 days from the date of r equest, the requesting party may approach the Court of Competent jurisdiction to appoint an Arbitrator. T he decision of such arbitrator shall be final and binding on the parties. The venue of Arbitration shall be at Mumbai. The language of the Arbitration shall be English. c. Liquidated Damages (LD): Liquidated Damages (LD) shall be applicable as per GeM ATC. Note: Both Seller and Purchaser agree that the above percentages of LD are genuine pre-estimates of the loss/damage which the Purchaser would have suffered on account of delay/breach on the part of the Seller and the said amount will be payable on demand without there being any proof of the actual loss or damag e caused by such breach/delay. d. Bidder shall confirm HSN Code and GST Rate for quoted item. Note: Bidder shall ensure that the quoted price is inclusive of GST. . 6.
